patch_description: Retains the shared collective RY mode and the proven parallel CZ matching while removing redundant echo, RZ, and parametrized-entangler stages. This preserves the minimum one trainable parameter per external repetition, maintains full-register participation and entanglement, and cuts the ansatz block from 24–40 gates to 12 gates. The reduced depth should lower simulation cost and overfitting risk without sacrificing the symmetry that achieved perfect validation accuracy in the supplied candidates.
